citations.primary: JSRL arXiv 2204.02372 (Uchendu et al., ICML 2023): guide policy acts during an early shrinking window, exploration policy takes over; guide-step counts form a curriculum.
citations.supporting: Kickstarting arXiv 1803.03835 (guide-only fast-start OK; decay schedules already in paper). Sensitivity arm only, not primary.

hypothesis.H1_dev: JSRL warm-started residual policy beats the frozen guard heuristic by mean native return >= 0 on dev seeds (paired, 20 seeds). H0: mean paired difference <= 0.
hypothesis.H1_confirm: reproduce on fresh confirm seeds; exploratory until then.

arms.control_scripted: guard heuristic, frozen implementation, measured fresh on the dev window before any training (never privileged)
arms.treatment_jsrl: PPO residual policy warm-started by the frozen guard as guide, shrinking guide window
arms.ablation_noguide: same PPO config, no guide window (random init); isolates warm-start-specific effect
arms.sensitivity_kickstarting: same PPO config, kickstarting bonus on frozen guide Action logits, geometric beta decay (secondary, exploratory)

curriculum_prereg.guide: guard (frozen scripted); guide actions restricted to simulator-valid masks only; guide NEVER sees privileged state
curriculum_prereg.schedule: guide window per PPO iteration i: H_i = max(H0 * d^i, H_min) for i from 1; guide acts for the first H_i steps of each episode, exploration policy the rest
curriculum_prereg.reason: H0=200 balances sparse reward onset (~step 135 first nonzero) against transfer decay; d=0.6 gives full handover by iteration 5; floor avoids zero-credit floor collapse
